name: JW Anderson
why: Jonathan Anderson's own laboratory — fun-weird British design where a pigeon can be a clutch; the ideas his bigger houses run on, at their source.
origin: Jonathan Anderson, Northern Ireland-born, London, 2008 — ran his own label alongside transforming Loewe, then took fashion's biggest jobs; the JW line stays the sketchbook.
opview: Positions the label as ideas first — playful, gender-fluid, deliberately odd.

onething.n: the anchor is the house logo; the chain link is their loafer hardware, not a knit — verify link

notes.avant: the pigeon-clutch school — surrealism at wearable scale
notes.style: the sketchbook of fashion's busiest mind
notes.weird: pigeon clutch, frog loafers — a national treasure of odd

cities: London · Dover Street Market · luxury e-tail
